connection.TWlsdnVzUmVzdENsaWVudA.scheme.source:
A connection to a [Milvus](https://milvus.io) or [Zilliz Cloud](https://zilliz.com) (managed Milvus) vector database via the REST v2 API.

Authentication: Bearer token (Milvus / Zilliz token).

The connection uses the `milvus://` URL scheme for plain HTTP and `milvuss://` for servers behind TLS.
connection.TWlsdnVzUmVzdENsaWVudA.scheme.message:
Una connessione a un database vettoriale [Milvus](https://milvus.io) o [Zilliz Cloud](https://zilliz.com) (Milvus gestito) tramite l'API REST v2.

Autenticazione: token Bearer (token Milvus / Zilliz).

La connessione utilizza lo schema `milvus://` per HTTP non cifrato e `milvuss://` per server protetti da TLS.

connection.TWlsdnVzUmVzdENsaWVudA.scheme.source: Bearer token.  For local Milvus this is the `<user>:<password>` auth combo; for Zilliz Cloud it's the cluster API key.
connection.TWlsdnVzUmVzdENsaWVudA.scheme.message: Token Bearer. Per Milvus locale, si tratta del combo di autenticazione `<user>:<password>`; per Zilliz Cloud, si tratta della chiave API del cluster.

connection.TWlsdnVzUmVzdENsaWVudA.scheme.source: A connection to a Milvus / Zilliz Cloud vector database
